summary: Ubuntu 21.04 (Hirsute Hippo) was released on 22 April 2021. Features: GNOME 3.38 with Wayland default on most systems, kernel 5.11, Firefox as snap by default (replacing .deb). The hippo is hefty and distinctive; 'hirsute' means hairy. Privacy improvements and desktop polish.
notes: Unsupported since 2022-01-20. Kernel 5.11. Firefox snap default caused some debate; performance and theme issues were reported.
